name: OSU-6162
summary: OSU-6162, also known as PNU-96391, is a compound which acts as a partial agonist at both dopamine D2 receptors and 5-HT2A receptors. It acts as a dopamine stabilizer in a similar manner to the closely related drug pridopidine, and has antipsychotic, anti-addictive and anti-Parkinsonian effects in animal studies.

summaryZh: OSU-6162，也稱為PNU-96391，是一種含氮有機硫化合物，化學式C15H23NO2S，結構上與普利多匹定類似，區別在於OSU-6162為3-苯基哌啶結構，而PL-101為4-苯基哌啶結構。OSU-6162可作為多巴胺受體D2和5-HT2A受體的部分激動劑。
